# Curve

`Curve` is an object type. You don't create it directly: you get one from another call, then call its methods with a colon, e.g. `curve:name()`.

## Methods

| Function | Description | Since |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`name()`](name.md) | Get / Set the curve name. | 1.1.0 |
| [`type()`](type.md) | Get / Set the type of the curve. | 1.1.0 |
| [`exponent()`](exponent.md) | Get / Set the exponent of the curve. | 1.1.0 |
| [`weight()`](weight.md) | Get / Set the weight of the exponent curve. | 1.1.0 |
| [`offset()`](offset.md) | Get / Set the offset of the exponent curve. | 1.1.0 |
| [`functionType()`](functionType.md) | Get / Set the type of the function curve. | 1.1.0 |
| [`pointsCount()`](pointsCount.md) | Get / Set the points count of the custom curve. | 1.1.0 |
| [`easyMode()`](easyMode.md) | Get / Set the custom curve mode (1 is easyMode / -1 not) | 1.1.0 |
| [`smooth()`](smooth.md) | Get / Set the custom curve smooth (1 is smooth / -1 not) | 1.1.0 |
| [`point()`](point.md) | Get / Set the point of the custom curve by index. | 1.1.0 |
